summary: Route each request to the server or account token header by path, pick servers by name through the account token, and mask server API tokens in responses.
reason: Postmark endpoints accept exactly one of two token headers, and sending both to GET /server returns 401 ErrorCode 10. The generator cannot attach one credential per operation, so a client hook deletes the header the path does not accept. The same file adds --server/--sandbox, servers use/tokens, offset=0 on paged GETs (Postmark rejects count without offset), and no-prune sync --full. Selecting a server also clears a saved auth_header or static server-token header on the in-memory config, since the client would otherwise send those instead of the selected server's token.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; live dogfood 372/372 with both tokens set; GET /server and GET /servers return masked ApiTokens.
